intro.title: Build file upload endpoint with validation
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a file upload endpoint using Node.js that accepts and validates user-uploaded files. You'll learn how to handle multipart form data, check file properties like size and type, and securely store the uploaded files on the server. The core programming concept involves processing HTTP requests, implementing validation logic, and managing file streams. You'll use Express.js for the web framework and the 'multer' middleware to handle file uploads, applying these tools to create a robust, beginner-friendly endpoint.
intro.usecase: File upload endpoints with validation are essential in virtually any application that handles user-generated content. You'll see this pattern in social media platforms like Instagram where users upload profile pictures with size and format restrictions, in document management systems like Google Drive that validate file types before storage, and in job application portals that accept resumes with specific file requirements. As a Node.js developer, you'll implement these endpoints to securely handle user uploads while preventing malicious files, ensuring data integrity, and providing clear feedback when uploads fail validation.
